description:
The pkits_crl.rs test suite covers PKITS §4.15 delta CRL scenarios well, but does not test the edge case of an empty base CRL (no revoked entries) combined with a non-empty delta CRL.

This is relevant because with an empty base and a non-empty delta:
- with_delta construction should succeed (empty base is valid)
- check_revocation with a cert that IS in the delta should return Revoked
- check_revocation with a cert NOT in either should return Ok

The current tests all use CA1 or CA2 base CRLs that have revoked entries. The empty-base case exercises the delta_entries path without the base_entries fallback, which is a different code path at line 296-303.

Also missing: a test where the base CRL has a revoked serial and the delta CRL's revoked list is empty (cert should still be revoked from base). This exercises line 296-303 when delta_entries is empty.

Location: pkix-revocation/tests/pkits_crl.rs (no test for empty-base + non-empty-delta)

Note: deltaCRLCA3CRL may be an empty base (it has no revoked entries per the §4.15.9/4.15.10 comments). Using deltaCRLCA3CRL as base and deltaCRLCA3deltaCRL as delta would test this case. Add a dedicated test.
title: Missing test: delta CRL with empty base and non-empty delta
